notes.title: Tiny fix with 0.7.3
notes.content:
Hi guys!

A very, very small issue is fixed: Now you can customize the input control for setting the mine velocity. So you may use a mouse without mouse wheel.

This is a requirement for a new feature coming soon: I want to add full controller support, as this was wished by several players. Not as easy as it should be, but you may look forward.

notes.title: Version 0.7.2 released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After a long break (sorry!) development goes on. As promised you get some visual stuff this time, so enjoy the improved backgrounds. They look particularly impressive on a high resolutin screen.
Aside from that, there are some small changes like a custom mouse cursor and glowing rocket engines.

Have fun!

notes.title: Version 0.7.1 released!
notes.content:
Hello Gravinauts!

The first update includes over a dozen small changes:

a lot of fixes of tiny errors concerning sound, multiplayer, challenges, and head-up display
some challenges are now a little bit easier and better to understand
some comfort changes like a spaceship headlight indicator


The next update will probably contain more visual stuff, so you may look forward. And don’t forget to join our Discord server discord.gg/qScSYNV, especially when you want to fight some online battles!

notes.title: Join us on Discord!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Frank here. I created a Discord server for meeting other players: discord.gg/qScSYNV

After joining you can

arrange to meet others for online matches,
discuss about the game, possible bugs, and desired features, and
talk with former testers and the developer.


Online matches are really much fun, so try it — but you better have trained enough before!
